items.title: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch
items.summary: Russias largest bank, Sberbank, has secured crypto exchange authorization as it prepares to offer Bitcoin, Ether and Tether USDt trading.

items.title: ENS seeks DAO approval to activate upgraded Ethereum naming system
items.summary: New .eth registrations would pause for hours during the transition, while existing domain holders could renew their names without migrating.

items.title: Metaplanet to issue $329M convertible bonds to pay debt, fund share buybacks
items.summary: Metaplanet plans to issue zero-interest bonds with a five-year maturity to improve its debt structure and cut its reliance on Bitcoin-collateralized loans without selling holdings.

items.title: MediaMarktSaturn pulls Ledger products amid tampering reports
items.summary: European retailer MediaMarkt pulled Ledger products as the wallet maker probes tampering reports beyond CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia.

items.title: Bitcoin hits $84K resistance as Korean tech rout deepens KOSPI losses
items.summary: Bitcoins liquidity kept BTC price below $84,000 amid a mounting South Korean tech and semiconductor stock sell-off.

items.title: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
items.summary: Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 seized Bitcoin face a legal setback after a UK court ruled that Chinese law governs their claims.
